_readme: Which Jira fixVersions count as real release commitments.
A version listed here is NOT a release train — it is a backlog, patch bucket,
config container, staging queue or platform workstream. Versions listed here
never set a due date and never make a game 'late'. Everything NOT listed is
treated as a committed release when it carries a release date.
Published deliberately: exclusions are visible, not hidden build logic.
